# MEOK AI Labs — Starter AI Compliance Infrastructure

## Core Products
- MEOK AI OS: https://www.meok.ai/ — Personal UK-hosted AI operating system
- MEOK Compliance: https://proofof.ai/ — AI compliance MCP server fleet
- CSOAI Council: https://csoai.org/ — AI safety certification & governance
- COBOL Bridge: https://cobolbridge.ai/ — Legacy modernisation
- COBOL Bridge SPEC: https://cobolbridge.ai/SPEC.md — COBOL→OpenTelemetry bridge spec (measurement, never certification)
